# Public, non-sensitive receipt-v1 canonicalization vectors.

# `material_hex` is the exact ASCII canonical material encoded as lowercase
# hex. `sha256` is SHA-256 of the decoded bytes. The paired changes deliberately
# distinguish otherwise ambiguous field boundaries and individually bind the
# ID/body (batch), sender/timestamp/source kind/source ordinal (frame).
